sentence: This project studies how to make statistical methods used in deep learning and big data analysis work better.
This project builds a system of smart cameras that analyzes streaming video in real time while protecting private information.
This project uses glass that gives off ultraviolet light to study how bacteria respond to light and stick to surfaces.
This project builds faster ways to train deep neural networks so they can control power converters in real time on small embedded devices.
This project studies how plants turn smoke chemicals called karrikins into signals and how a family of proteins controls this process.
This project studies how humans and synthetic agents learn to adjust to each other during a shared learning task.
This project builds a laboratory with equipment for studying how plants, animals and ecosystems respond to outside and inside drivers of change.
This project studies how bacteria living on sinking bits of ocean matter affect whether carbon stays in the deep ocean.
This project builds tools that automatically hunt for security weaknesses in large scientific software written in many languages.
This project designs seed carriers that bury themselves so tree seeds are protected and more of them sprout.
This project builds a wireless brain implant with flexible polymer shanks that record signals from neurons without wires.
This project designs deep neural network hardware that uses little energy and can detect and repair its own faults so it lasts longer.
This project studies how bacteria in a community that eats methane talk to each other with chemical signals.
This project tests how well real-time monitoring, automated incident response and context-aware authentication protect research computing from cyber threats.
This project uses machine learning to find genes that help a thermotolerant yeast make more biochemicals and biofuels.
This project studies how snow, forests and frozen soil control water storage and movement in peatlands.
This project builds an AI tool that quickly simulates electromagnetic waves for short-range wireless links on silicon.
This project studies how to control large language models, defend them against attacks and use quantum computing for language tasks.
This project studies how using social media affects how adolescent girls feel about their bodies.
